description: Retunes a stream of standard twelve-tone pitches to a scale tuned in whole number ratios

params.text: Picks the note the scale is built on, C to B; the scale's ratios are taken from that note rather than from C
Picks which scale of the file the pitches are tuned to, and names the twelve notes of that scale in the list below it

inputs.text: The pitches to be retuned, one per channel, read as standard 1V per octave

outputs.text: The retuned pitches, one per channel, in 1V per octave, each note moved to its ratio in the scale

notes: the scales come from res/default_scales.json in the installed plugin folder; a scales.json placed beside it is read instead, and is used only if it loads without errors
